The *Abhirūpanandātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 36) is a verse narrative belonging to the *Therīapadāna* section of the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The text recounts the spiritual lineage, past-life deeds, and attainment of liberation of the elder nun Abhirūpanandā, whose verses and biography are also linked to the *Abhirūpanandātherīgāthā* (Thig 2.1) as well as the *Sundarīnandātherīgāthā* (Thig 5.4), *Vaṅgīsattheragāthā* (Thag 21.1), and *Khemātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 18) [SuttaCentral]. Modern accessibility includes five translations in five languages listed on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
